title: Marvelous Designer Unreal Fest 2025 Exhibition Review
description:
We sincerely thank every friend who came to the Marvelous Designer booth, enthusiastically connecting with us and discussing technology. Your enthusiasm and every piece of feedback are the most important driving forces in our product optimization journey.

We hope this brief encounter adds a new energy to your future creative endeavors.

See you next time! 👋

summary: ```# Marvelous Designer Unreal Fest 2025 Exhibition Review ## Introduction Hello, everyone, we meet again. This time we not only have a talk session, we also have a manager. Thank you very much for your enthusiasm. It can make our position full of joy and laughter. I hope everyone can continue to pay attention to the software of Marvelous Designer in the future. We will also have more and more interaction with you on our community platform. ## Increasing Adoption of Marvelous Designer More and more game customers use the process of Marvelous Designer to Unreal Engine (UE). So, when I was communicating with customers, I gradually became familiar with this process. The introduction of Marvelous Designer to UE and data interconnection are very convenient. ## Workflow Efficiency After using Marvelous Designer, we can start from GB, the process of layout, and then turn to this side. It will save a lot of time collecting materials and greatly improve the efficiency of work. I have been using Marvelous Designer to UE for six years, and I think the professionalism of this software is incomparable. ## Smooth Integration Currently, the combination of Marvelous Designer and Unreal Engine is very smooth. I am particularly concerned about the AI generation version of Marvelous Designer to UE, as it can help developers reduce the threshold of creation and improve the efficiency of creation. ## Future Developments In addition, I also look forward to the future of Marvelous Designer to develop the function of creating clothes directly in Unreal Engine. ```
